versions.changelog:
Initial release: Automated accessibility testing for Layer 11.

- Provides automated WCAG 2.1 and 2.2 compliance testing (Levels A, AA, AAA)
- Covers screen reader compatibility, keyboard navigation, color contrast, and ARIA validation
- Simulates assistive technologies (screen reader, keyboard-only navigation, high contrast, magnification)
- Generates structured accessibility compliance reports with remediation guidance
- Integrates with broader testing orchestration in the ASF system
